name: signup-flow
title: Signup Flow
description: A cursor-driven signup card: labeled Full Name, Email, Password and Confirm Password fields fill top to bottom, then Create account runs hover, press, loading and success as a confirmation toast slides in.
useWhen: Showing a full onboarding or signup flow in a product launch or demo video.
Demonstrating a realistic form-fill interaction with an animated cursor and field progression.
You need a ready auth scene with zero assembly and the default field layout fits.
avoidWhen: You need a generic form with custom fields: compose input, button and cursor manually.
You only need the success notification: use toast directly.
You need a settings interaction walkthrough: use settings-toggle-flow.
author: Remocn
